presets.name: Research
presets.description: Milestone 8: both hands. The treble, F3-A6, five ranks per key -- L, M−, M, M+, H -- opened by the 14 registers; the Stradella bass, twelve pitch classes on 16′, 8′, 8-4′, 4′ and 2′, opened by the 7 bass registers, its bass buttons on MIDI channel 2 and its chords on 3. All tuned to A440, a reed for each way the bellows moves (CC 80), one bellows the arm pushes, a cassotto for L and M (off by default). Every reed is scaled from the F4 the IfM Zwota measured.
